Authors: Luke Hollis, Tianxing Fan, Heng Yang

Intrinsic Goals for Autonomous Agents: Hierarchical Exploration Captures Future Volitional Action in Drosophila Other

intrinsic motivation hierarchical policy digital twin neural representation DIAYN

简要说明：本文利用果蝇全脑记录和神经力学数字孪生，证明层次化内在动机智能体（特别是DIAYN）能够匹配果蝇的探索行为和未来意志动作的神经表征，为逆向工程动物自主性提供了框架。

TLDR: This paper uses whole-brain recordings in Drosophila and a neuromechanical digital twin to show that hierarchical intrinsically motivated agents, particularly DIAYN, can match fly exploratory behavior and neural representations of future volitional action, providing a framework for reverse-engineering animal autonomy.

Abstract: Animals have a remarkable capacity for autonomy---driven by intrinsic motivation---without external sensory cues or extrinsic objectives, yet the computational mechanisms behind this ability largely remain a mystery. We combine whole-brain recordings in the fruit fly (Drosophila melanogaster), which reveal neural representations of spontaneous exploratory decisions more than 10 seconds in advance, with a neuromechanical digital twin to test whether optimizing intrinsic goals yields realistically embodied artificial agents that quantitatively match fly behavior and internal representations of future volitional action during exploration. Our hierarchical policy selects from a discrete library of low-level motor primitives, consistent with ethological theories of behavioral syllables. We train agents without external reward using 20 intrinsic motivation algorithms spanning curiosity, entropy, and competency methods. The agents are evaluated in a virtual tethered-ball assay modeled on the fly experiment, comparing spontaneous locomotor statistics and internal representations and decoding future turn direction from kinematics and neural activity on the same timescales observed in flies. DIAYN, a hierarchical competency algorithm learning discrete policies that maximize behavioral entropy and the separability of induced sensory observations, achieves the strongest joint behavioral and neural prospective coding performance relative to flies. Its learned policies closely capture individual variability in fly exploration strategies, suggesting that this diversity serves to maximize state-space coverage at the population level. DIAYN's latent activity also closely captures the sum-difference rule for interhemispheric encoding of kinematics in biological flies. These results establish hierarchical, intrinsically motivated agents as a powerful framework for reverse-engineering animal autonomy.

摘要（中文）：动物具有通过内在动机驱动的显著自主能力，这种能力无需外部感官线索或外在目标即可实现，然而其背后的计算机制在很大程度上仍是未解之谜。我们将果蝇（黑腹果蝇）的全脑记录——该记录揭示了自发性探索决策在提前10秒以上的神经表征——与神经力学数字孪生相结合，以检验优化内在目标是否能够产生逼真的具身人工代理，使其在行为上定量匹配果蝇，并在内部表征上复现探索过程中未来意志性动作的神经编码。我们的层级策略从离散的低层运动原语库中进行选择，这与行为音节学的动物行为学理论相一致。我们使用涵盖好奇心、熵和能力方法的20种内在动机算法，在无外部奖励的条件下训练代理。代理在模拟果蝇实验的虚拟拴球装置中接受评估，比较自发运动统计量及内部表征，并在与果蝇观察相同的时标上，从运动学和神经活动中解码未来转向方向。DIAYN——一种学习离散策略以最大化行为熵和所诱发感官观测可分离性的层级能力算法——在与果蝇的对比中，实现了最强的行为与神经前瞻编码联合表现。其学习到的策略紧密捕捉了果蝇探索策略中的个体差异，表明这种多样性在群体层面上旨在最大化状态空间覆盖。DIAYN的潜在活动还紧密复现了生物果蝇中运动学半球间编码的和差规则。这些结果确立了层级内在动机代理作为逆向工程动物自主性的强大框架。

Authors: Declan Kutscher, Reece Keller, Alyn Kirsch, Felix Pei, Aran Nayebi

TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration Other

token pruning joint source-channel coding 3D-VQA LVLM cloud-edge collaboration

简要说明：TP-JSCC 提出了一种 token 剪枝与联合源信道编码方法，用于在云端 LVLM 进行 3D 视觉问答时，高效压缩并传输来自具身智能体的视觉 token，在保持性能的同时大幅降低数据量和计算开销。

TLDR: TP-JSCC introduces a token pruning and joint source-channel coding method to efficiently compress and transmit visual tokens from embodied agents to cloud-based LVLMs for 3D visual question answering, reducing data volume and computational cost while preserving performance.

Abstract: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.

摘要（中文）：在资源受限的具身智能体上部署大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）以完成三维视觉问答任务，亟需云边协同的支持。然而，通过带宽有限且存在噪声的信道将大规模视觉数据卸载至云端，会引入严重的传输延迟与失真。针对这一问题，本文提出TP-JSCC——一种面向云边协同下基于LVLMs的3D-VQA任务的高效令牌剪枝与联合信源信道编码方法。首先，我们设计了一种基于局部与全局语义的混合令牌剪枝模块（LGS-HTP），以显著减少视觉令牌数量。通过解耦前景与背景令牌，并联合选择局部与全局语义，LGS-HTP在有效降低冗余的同时保留了推理关键令牌。其次，我们引入了一种轻量级令牌联合信源信道编码模块（T-JSCC），以进一步压缩剪枝后的令牌，并确保其在易错信道中的鲁棒传输。该模块采用轻量级级联线性层及信噪比（SNR）自适应机制，能够适应波动的信道条件，同时保持极低的计算开销。在ScanQA和SQA3D数据集上的大量实验表明，本方法具备优异的效率与鲁棒性。具体而言，在ScanQA验证集上，LGS-HTP模块可实现90%的剪枝率，同时CIDEr指标损失小于1%。在此基础上，T-JSCC进一步将令牌压缩18倍，使总数据量减少180倍以实现鲁棒传输，同时为LVLM部署节省90%的计算复杂度。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC。

Authors: Zhengxin Li, Chongzhen Tian, Hui Yuan, Hao Liu, Sam Kwong

OVM-Occ: Open-Vocabulary Monocular Occupancy Prediction via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Distillation Perception3D

open-vocabulary occupancy prediction language-embedded Gaussians geometry-aware distillation indoor scene understanding vision-language distillation

简要说明：OVM-Occ 提出了一种基于高斯的室内开放词汇单目占据预测框架，通过语言嵌入的高斯表示、几何感知注意力和实例级视觉-语言蒸馏，实现对未定义类别的细粒度三维语义预测。

TLDR: OVM-Occ introduces a Gaussian-based open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction framework for indoor scenes, using language-embedded Gaussians, geometry-aware attention, and instance-level vision-language distillation to predict fine-grained 3D semantics beyond predefined categories.

Abstract: Monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes aims to recover a scene's 3D geometry and semantics from a single RGB image. Existing methods are restricted to a closed set of predefined categories, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen categories. This limitation is particularly critical in indoor scenes, where objects exhibit highly diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. We study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based occupancy framework with an instance-aware vision-language teacher. Specifically, we adopt Language-Embedded Gaussians as the intermediate scene representation, propose a geometry-aware deformable attention module to refine Gaussian semantic features, and construct instance-level vision-language embeddings to provide reliable semantic supervision. We further introduce geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation to mitigate the interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. To evaluate open-vocabulary occupancy prediction performance, we introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art approach by 12.2 mIoU and 0.6 IoU on the Occ-ScanNet dataset, with consistent gains under new open-vocabulary evaluation protocols.

摘要（中文）：室内场景中的单目占用预测旨在从单一RGB图像中恢复场景的三维几何结构和语义信息。现有方法局限于预定义类别的封闭集合，难以泛化到未见类别。这一局限性在室内场景中尤为关键，因为室内物体呈现出高度多样且细粒度的语义类别。本文研究室内场景中的开放词汇单目占用预测，并提出OVM-Occ——一种带有实例感知视觉-语言教师的高斯占用框架。具体而言，我们采用语言嵌入高斯作为中间场景表示，提出几何感知的可变形注意力模块以细化高斯语义特征，并构建实例级视觉-语言嵌入以提供可靠的语义监督。我们进一步引入几何感知的解耦语义蒸馏，以减轻几何学习与语义学习之间的相互干扰。为评估开放词汇占用预测性能，我们引入了OpenOcc-ScanNet和OpenOcc-Replica两个扩展基准，其包含更多样且细粒度的语义类别。实验表明，我们的方法在室内场景开放词汇单目占用预测中取得了最先进的性能，在Occ-ScanNet数据集上分别以12.2 mIoU和0.6 IoU的优势超越先前的最先进方法，并在新的开放词汇评估协议下持续获得性能提升。

Authors: Shuyang Yu, Haibo Qin, Shaohan Hu, Wei Shan, Xiaoqing Guan, You Wang, Guang Li

FlockWorld: Toward Population-Scale Multi-Agent Video World Models through Artificial Life Simulation WorldModel

multi-agent video world models action-conditioned latent diffusion flow matching artificial life egocentric video generation

简要说明：FlockWorld 是一个用于研究大规模多智能体视频世界模型的人工生命环境，FlockDiT 是一个动作条件的潜扩散变换器，可为多个智能体联合生成同步的自我中心视频。

TLDR: FlockWorld is an artificial-life environment for studying population-scale multi-agent video world models, and FlockDiT is an action-conditioned latent diffusion transformer that jointly generates synchronized egocentric videos for multiple agents.

Abstract: Most action-conditioned video world models remain limited to a single player, while existing multiplayer models support only small, fixed groups of agents. We introduce FlockWorld, an artificial-life environment built on Reynolds's Boids algorithm for studying population-scale multi-agent video world models. Specifically, FlockWorld renders synchronized egocentric crops, assigns distinct colors to preserve camera-agent identity across views, exposes rule-derived accelerations as actions, and lets the number of camera agents be configured independently of the size of the surrounding population. We further introduce FlockDiT, an action-conditioned latent diffusion transformer trained with flow matching on FlockWorld data to jointly generate synchronized egocentric videos for multiple agents. Our results suggest that joint generation benefits agent detection at density-matched settings and that diffusion forcing improves rollout fidelity. Together, FlockWorld and FlockDiT provide a controlled testbed for multi-agent video generation.

摘要（中文）：大多数基于动作条件的视频世界模型仍局限于单一玩家，而现有的多玩家模型仅支持规模较小且固定的智能体群体。我们引入了FlockWorld，一个基于Reynolds的Boids算法构建的人工生命环境，用于研究群体规模的多智能体视频世界模型。具体而言，FlockWorld渲染同步的自我中心视角裁剪，通过分配不同的颜色来保持各视角下相机智能体的身份一致性，将规则推导出的加速度作为动作暴露出来，并允许相机智能体的数量独立于周围群体规模进行配置。我们进一步引入了FlockDiT，一种基于动作条件的潜在扩散变换器，利用流匹配在FlockWorld数据上进行训练，以联合生成多个智能体的同步自我中心视频。我们的结果表明，在密度匹配的设置下，联合生成有利于智能体检测，且扩散强迫提高了推演的保真度。综合来看，FlockWorld和FlockDiT为多智能体视频生成提供了一个受控的测试平台。
